scope: One authorized revision and new20 paired development diagnostic complete. Do not start another prompt/parser revision or expand chat-based extraction.
evidence_type: AI-assisted source adjudication; neither gold truth nor a random accuracy estimate

dimension_decisions.experience_object: candidate_only; general vs relevant and domain vs task still misclassified
dimension_decisions.explicit_years: scalar thresholds not accepted; repeated unsupported task-to-tool propagation, formula ratios and exact-value assumptions
dimension_decisions.qualification_substitution: conditional/unconditional statistics not accepted; both readers missed a preferred work-or-training condition
dimension_decisions.technology_role: retain overlapping candidate findings, no exclusive role assignment; omitted applicant AI use/integration evidence remains
dimension_decisions.cross_technology_class: not accepted as complete inventory; traditional software findings omitted despite explicit evidence
dimension_decisions.missingness: absence of extracted finding not validated absence of requirement

accepted_releases: frozen coverage and valid-date time-risk descriptives
old candidate sensitivity figures, explicitly nonvalidated measurements
v1.1 AI comparison and error diagnoses, not population estimates
L3 offline cached-output validation interface, not model execution
substantive_rulings: Relevant job experience is not unrestricted total employment tenure.
Task-experience years do not automatically attach to every tool named in the same sentence.
An experience-to-education conversion ratio is not an absolute number of required work years.
An experience-or-training branch is not unconditional work experience even under a preferred heading.
AI use, implementation, and development can overlap; report multiple supported roles.
Software/AI contrasts need comparable applicant-role evidence; empty extracted software arrays are not evidence of no software demand.

next_execution_state.next_action: Release current reproducible results and task-specific limitations. Keep existing data available; do not requeue full cleaning or API-dependent tasks.

comparison_interpretation.occupation_task_duration_signature_agree: 13/20 including jointly empty cases, not extraction accuracy
comparison_interpretation.original_B_AI_candidate_presence: Each reader marks AI presence in 2/10 original B records; development diagnostic only, not population contamination estimate. Original software grouping must not be relabeled known non-AI.
comparison_interpretation.role_and_class_presence: Overlapping categories; do not force exhaustive mutually exclusive AI groups.
